method: Inclusion is every species printed under the Pteropodidae heading on the 2011 Wayback SANParks KNP mammal checklist PDF (3 species). English and Afrikaans names, and species order, are taken from that PDF. Scientific names are the 2011 names unless an iNaturalist taxon record cited in remaps gives a current name. Research-grade counts are for iNaturalist place_id 69020. iNaturalist-only pteropodidae are in candidates, not species. The PDF was fetched to a temporary path for text extraction and was not copied into this project.

remaps.note: This is a recorded split, not a simple synonym. An iNaturalist taxa search for the 2011 name matches Epomophorus gambianus (taxon 40812, preferred_common_name Gambian Epauletted Fruit Bat), which remains an active species. The same search also matches Epomophorus crypturus (taxon 64485, preferred_common_name Peters's Epauletted Fruit Bat) via the term Epomophorus gambianus crypturus. The 2011 checklist already prints the synonym (=E. crypturus crypturus) and the English name Peters' epauletted fruit bat. Place 69020 has 1 observation of any grade identified as E. crypturus (0 research-grade); E. gambianus does not appear in the place Pteropodidae taxonomy tree (0 research-grade). E. crypturus lists Epomophorus gambianus crypturus as an invalid scientific name, but not the binomial Epomophorus gambianus itself. The Kruger taxon is stored as E. crypturus because that is the iNaturalist species whose preferred common name is Peters's Epauletted Fruit Bat and which has the Kruger record.
iNaturalist preferred_common_name for the current Kruger taxon. Peters' Epauletted Fruit Bat remains a listed English name on the same taxon. The stored en value is the 2011 SANParks checklist name.

gaps: Live SANParks checklist HTML and PDF were not fetched in this session (Phase 1 recorded HTTP 403). Inclusion is the 2011 Wayback PDF only, and has not been compared with the live 147–148 figure.
iNaturalist checklist 8810 was not fetched (Phase 1 recorded HTTP 403/401).

The binomial Epomophorus gambianus is not listed as an invalid scientific name of E. crypturus (only the trinomial Epomophorus gambianus crypturus is). That missing species-level synonym link is logged; the Kruger taxon is still stored as E. crypturus because of the 2011 English name, the printed synonym, and the Kruger record.

Almost all Kruger fruit-bat observations are not identified to species: the place taxonomy tree has 496 observations of any grade under Epomophorus, of which 494 are at genus rank. species_counts returned a genus-rank row for Epomophorus (70 research-grade). Those counts were not treated as a species identification of either official Epomophorus.

Epomophorus wahlbergi and Rousettus aegyptiacus are on the official list, but have 0 research-grade iNaturalist observations in place 69020 (E. wahlbergi has 1 observation of any grade; R. aegyptiacus is absent from the tree). Absence of an iNat record was not treated as absence from KNP.

No rare, reintroduced, or introduced flags are recorded for official Pteropodidae species: the 2011 PDF does not mark any of them with an asterisk or other status note (asterisks on that list are only for house mouse and house/black rat under Muridae).
Candidate Afrikaans names were left null. The Phase 2 rule was to take af from the 2011 SANParks checklist; these taxa are not on that list.
The current live official list, Skinner & Chimimba, and Stuart's guide were not available to corroborate remaps or flags.
